model_output:
```sql
WITH mingo_county AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Mingo County'
    AND border_type = 'county'
    AND addr_state = 'WV'
),
poi_in_mingo AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.poi_name, p.geometry
  FROM pois p, mingo_county mc
  WHERE ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, mc.geometry::geometry)
    AND p.tourism = 'attraction'
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, true, 'average')).geom AS slope_geom,
    (ST_Slope(r.rast, 1, true, 'average')).val AS slope_val
  FROM public.dem_us r, mingo_county mc
  WHERE ST_Intersects(r.rast::geometry, mc.geometry::geometry)
),
poi_slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id, 
    p.poi_name,
    AVG(s.slope_val) AS avg_slope
  FROM poi_in_mingo p
  JOIN slope_raster s ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, s.slope_geom)
  GROUP BY p.id, p.poi_name
)
SELECT *
FROM poi_slope_analysis
ORDER BY avg_slope DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
